name: Core Allocation
description: Codifies SWE core allocation (performance vs efficiency) and model-by-difficulty assignment so TPM dispatches at the right scale and cost.

performanceCores.label: Performance Cores
performanceCores.description: Number of high-capability SWE slots for main-task work (primary code, complex logic, critical path). Always dispatched first.

efficiencyCores.label: Efficiency Cores
efficiencyCores.description: Number of lower-priority SWE slots for side tasks (minor fixes, research, simple changes) while performance cores are busy. Set to 0 to disable.

modelByDifficulty.label: Model By Difficulty
modelByDifficulty.description: Maps task difficulty to model name; TPM selects per dispatch. Defaults: Haiku for low, Sonnet for medium, Opus for high.

highPriorityMode.label: High Priority Mode
highPriorityMode.description: How TPM dispatches a high-priority task. all-hands (default): deploys every SWE slot. perf-only: uses performance cores only, efficiency stays on standby. normal: ignores priority hints.

announceDispatchPlan.label: Announce Dispatch Plan
announceDispatchPlan.description: When on (default), TPM tells the user its dispatch plan before spawning SWEs. When off, TPM dispatches silently.
